m: उद्-√ भा P. -भाति, to become visible, appear, Mn.; BhP.

उद्-√ भास् P. Ā. -भासति, -ते, to come forth or appear brightly, shine, MBh.; R.; Kathās.; to become visible, strike, MBh. v, 728 : Caus. P. Ā. -भासयति, -ते, to illuminate, light up, Hariv.; VP.; VarBṛS.; Kathās.; to make apparent or prominent, cause to come forth, Bhartṛ. Comm. on Kum. i, 2; to render brilliant or beautiful, Mṛcch.; Ragh.
a: उद्भास् — {c1c} A. To shine. --Caus. 1 To light up, illuminate, render beautiful, decorate; ornament; उद्भासितं मंगलसंविधाभिः R. 7. 16; काले घनोद्भासिते Mk. 5. 35. --2 (fig.) To bring into prominence, elevate, exalt; उद्भासिताखिलखलस्य Bh. 2. 59.

v: udBAsa

m: उद्-भास m. radiance, splendour g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136 (not in the Kāś.)
a: उद्भासः — Radiance, splendour.

m: उद्-भास—वत् mfn. shining, radiant, ib.
उद्भासिन् mfn. shining, radiant, Kum.; Bhartṛ.
coming forth, appearing, Rājat.; Daśar.
giving or causing splendour, Mṛcch.
a: उद्भासिन्, उद्भासुर — a. Shining, radiant, splendid; विभूषणोद्भासि पिनद्धभोगि वा Ku. 5. 78; क्रीडारसोद्भासिनि Mk. 8. 38; Bh. 1. 80; Amaru. 81.

m: उद्-भासित mfn. come forth, appeared
lighted up, illuminated, splendid
ornamented, graced, beautiful.
उद्-भासुर mfn. shining, radiant, Amar.
उद्-भाव m. production, generation g. बलादि, Pāṇ. v, 2, 136
rising (of sounds), Puṣpas. ix, 4, 22.
a: उद्भावः — 1 Production, generation. --2 Magnanimity.

na॰ ud + BU--Ric--lyuw । 1 kalpane, 2 utpAdane ca ud + cu॰ BU॰ lyuw । 3 cintane 4 utgrekzaRe ca “udBAvanamakurvvantO vidurasya mate sTitAH” BA॰ A॰ 141 a॰
m: उद्-भावन n. the act of raising up, elevation, MBh. xiii, 2913; Lalit.
passing over, inattention, neglect, disregard, MBh.
announcement, communication, Naiṣ.
making visible, manifestation, Kāraṇḍ.
a: उद्भावनं — 1 Thinking, thinking over. --2 Production, generation, creation. --3 Speaking, saying. --4 Inattention, neglect, disregard.

m: उद्-भावयितृ mfn. one who raises upwards or elevates, Daś.
a: उद्भावयितृ — a. Raising upwards, lifting up, exalting (fig. also); उद्भावयिता बंधून् Dk. 153.

m: उद्भाविन् mfn. (Pāṇ. v, 2, 136) coming forth, becoming visible &c.
उद्-भावित mfn. caused to exist, created, produced, Sāh.

1. उद्-√ भू P. -भवति, to come up to, reach, be equal, ŚBr.; TBr.; to rise, rise against, Kathās.; to come forth, arise, exist, spring from, MBh.; Kathās.; Hariv.; Rājat. &c.; to shoot forth, increase, grow larger, thrive, MaitrUp.; Naiṣ. : Caus. -भावयति, to cause to exist, produce, Ragh. ii, 62; Vedāntas.; to make apparent, show, explain, MBh.; Sāh. &c.; to speak of, mention, Prasannar. Comm. on Bādar.; to consider, think (with two acc.), Vcar. ix, 19.
2. उद्-भू mf(भ्वी)n(भु). ‘being up to what is wanted’, sufficient
having persistency, persevering, AV. ix, 2, 16; xviii, 4, 26; VS. xv, 1.
a: उद्भू — {c1c} P. 1 To arise, spring up, be produced from; उदभून्मुरजध्वनिः, अंतरीक्षात्सरस्वती &c. see उद्भव below. --2 To occur, take place; उदभवत्तीव्रो दुर्भिक्षः Ks. 27. 94. --3 To ascend, go up, mount. --4 To suffice. --5 To rise in arms, revolt, rebel. --Caus. 1 To cause to exist, create, produce; मायां मयोद्भाव्य परीक्षितोसि R. 2. 62. --2 To proclaim; माहात्म्यं K. 109. --3 To use, employ. --4 To raise, elevate.

m: उद्-भूत mfn. come forth, produced, born
grown, MaitrUp.; MBh.; R.; Kathās. &c.
raised, elevated, increased, R.; Ṛtus.
visible, perceptible, distinct, positive, Bhāṣāp.
a: उद्भूत — p. p. 1 Born, produced, generated. --2 Lofty (lit. and fig.). --3 Visible, perceptible, capable of being perceived by the senses; as a गुण.

उद्-भूत—रूप mfn. having a visible shape.
उद्-भूत—स्पर्श-वत् mfn. having distinct or positive tangibility, tangible, Bhāṣāp. 55.
उद्-भूत—त्व n. the state of being increased, MaitrUp. v, 2.

elevation, increase, Kum.; Vikr.

उद्भस m. pl. N. of a people, MBh.

m: उद्-भव See उद्-√ भू.
उद्-भव m. existence, generation, origin, production, birth
springing from, growing
becoming visible, Yājñ.; Mn.; Kathās.; Pañcat. &c.
birth-place, ŚvetUp.; Kāvyād.
N. of a son of Nahuṣa, VP.
a sort of salt, L., (ifc.) mfn. produced or coming from, MBh.; Mn. &c.
a: उद्भव, उद्भावना — &c. See under उद्भू.

उद्भवः — 1 Production, creation, birth, generation (lit. and fig.); इति हेतुस्तदुद्भवे K. P. 1; Y. 3. 80; oft. at the end of comp. in the sense of ‘springing or arising from,’ ‘produced from’; ऊरूद्भवा V. 1. 3; मणिराकरोद्भवः R. 3. 18. --2 Source, origin; उद्भवो यशसः K. 54. --3 N. of Viṣṇu; उद्भवः क्षोभनो देवः V. Sah. --Comp. --कर a. productive. --क्षेत्रं birthplace.

k.v: जनुर्जननजन्मानि जनिरुत्पत्तिरुद्भवः। प्राणी तु चेतनो जन्मी जन्तुजन्युशरीरिणः॥

m: उद्-भव—कर mfn. productive.
उद्-भव-कोशक m. the womb, MārkP.
उद्-भव—क्षेत्र n. the place of origin, Daś.

m: उद्भट mfn. excellent, eminent, exalted, magnanimous, extraordinary, Bhar.; Viddh.
vehement, passionate, Gīt.
उद्भट m. a tortoise, L.
a fan for winnowing corn, L.
N. of an author.
a: उद्भट — a. 1 Excellent, pre-eminent; पदे पदे संति भटा रणोद्भटाः N. 1. 132. --2 Exalted, magnanimous. --टः 1 A fan for winnowing corn. --2 A tortoise.
उद्भट — One of the earliest writers on Alaṃkāra. He was the chief Paṇḍita or Sabhāpati of king Jayāpīda of Kāshmir (779-813 A. D.).

m: उद्भट—त्व n. weight, importance (of a contradiction), Sarvad.

v: udBeda

pu॰ ud + Bida--ac । 1 romAYce । BAve GaY । 2 udBidyotpattO 3 prakASe ca । “umAstanodBadamanu pravfdDaH” kumA॰ । “taM yovanodBedaviSezakAntam” raGuH । “puzpodBedaM saha kisalayErBUzaRAnAM viSezAt” meGa॰ । “kandodBedAvEdrumA vAriRIva” mAGaH । “hasitaMtu vfTAhAso yOvanodBedasamBavaH” “SfNgohi manmaTodBedastadAgamanahetukaH” sA॰ da॰ । 3 melane ca “gaNgodBedaM samAsAdya trirAtropozitonaraH” BA॰ va॰ 84 a॰ । lyuw । udBedanamapyatra na॰ । camasodBedanaM viprAstatrApi kaTayantyuta” BA॰ va॰ 88 a॰ । “udBedanaM prakASanam” udBicCabde SavaraBA॰ ।
m: उद्-भेद m. the act of breaking through or out, becoming manifest or visible, appearing, sprouting, Śak. 85 d; Kum.; Bhartṛ.; Sāh. &c.
(in dram.) the first manifestation of the germ (बीज) of the plot, Sāh.; Daśar.; Pratāpar.
a sprout or shoot of a plant, L.
a spring, fountain, R.; MBh.
treachery, Kathās.
mentioning, Prasannar.
a: उद्भेदः, --दनं — 1 Breaking through or out, becoming visible, appearance, display, manifestation, growth, development; किसलयोद्भेदप्रतिद्वंद्विभिः Ś. 4. 4; उमास्तनोद्भेदमनु प्रवृद्धः Ku. 7. 24; तं यौवनोद्भेदविशेषकांतं R. 5. 38; Śi. 18. 36; Mu. 5. 3. --2 Breaking, splitting; प्रस्तरोद्भदयोग्यः U. 3. 25. --3 A spring, fountain. --4 Horripilation; as in पुलकोद्भेद, रोमोद्भेद. --5 Treason, betrayal.

m: उद्-भेदन n. the act of breaking through or out, coming forth, MBh.; Car.

उद्-√ भृ P. Ā. -भरति, -ते (pf. -जभार pres. p. -भरत्; but -बिभ्रत्, Gīt. i, 16) to take or carry away or out, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; to take for one's self, choose, select, RV.; AV.; VS.; to raise up, elevate, RV. viii, 19, 23; to carry above, raise up, Gīt.

v: udBid

pu॰ BUmimudBinatti ud + Bid--kvip । 1 vfkzatfRagulmavallolatArUpe paYcaviDe sTAvaraBede udBijjaSabde udA॰ । udBinatti paSUn । 2 yAgaBede “udBidA yajeta” SrutiH udBidAdiSabdAnAM yaTA karmmanAmaDeyatA vyutpattisahitaM jE॰ sU॰ BAzyayostaTA darSitaM yaTA “uktaM samAmnAyEdamarTyaM tasmAt sarvvaM tadarTaM syAt 1, 4, 1, sU॰ । ‘udBidA yajeta’ ‘balavidA yajeta’ ‘aBijitA yajeta’ ‘viSvajitA yajeta’ iti samAmananti, tatra sandehaH, kim udBidAdayo guRaviDayaH, Ahosvit karmanAmaDeyAni iti । kutaH saMSayaH? uBayaTA'pi pratiBAti vAkyAt, udBidA ityeza Sabdo yajetEtyanena saMbaDyate, sa kiM vEyaDikaraRyena saMbanDamupEti, udBidA dravyeRa yAgamaBinirvarttayediti, uta sAmAnADikaraRyena, udBidA yAgena yajeta iti dbeDA'pi etasmin pratiBAti vAkye, sam Bavati saSayaH । kiM tAvat prAptam?
